dossier.public_summary: The dip changes dramatically between transits and between TESS sectors, from no detection to a large dip, so it cannot be a steady planet transit on this star. Only a nearby blended source or unreliable systematics explains the inconsistent depths, and difference imaging did not place the signal on the target.

reasons.why: Only one transit at ~269 +/-1091 ppm (S12) versus 12297 +/-1438 ppm (S39), 17575 +/-1707 ppm (S66) and 4287 +/-1280 ppm (S93) with chi2 94.01 on 3 dof; inconsistent co-added depth for a planet.
Significant changes within QLP and within TESS-SPOC separately rule out a steady-on-target transit as source of variation.

Individual transits inconsistent (mean 7082 ppm, chi2 102.04713065683943 on 6 dof) with top 3 carrying share 0.943, including epoch 0 at 18138 ppm (sigma 5.7) and epoch -100 at -1285 ppm (sigma -5.6).
Median planet is 0.5; rank near 0 indicates planet-unlike, under 0.1 threshold where false positives dominate.

No difference image localizing on target; many nearby stars within 1 TESS pixel can produce the variable depth with eclipses of 14.6-26.3% (closest 11.2 arcsec delta_mag 3.28), consistent with blended/nearbinary variability as best explanation.
reasons.value: verdict inconclusive, neighbours plausible_within_1px 3, could_cause_within_1px 6, contrast 0.1734
